Navi Mumbai has been ranked India’s cleanest city in the 10th edition of Swachh Survekshan 2025-26, with Mayor Sujata Patil receiving the country’s top honour from President Droupadi Murmu in New Delhi.
Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation (NMMC), in the first half of the year, implemented the Solid Waste Management Rules 2026, for which NMMC held a workshop to review cleanliness operations, which assessed ground-level programmes, and decided on the plans to implement the rules in June.
